- Paul McCartney

message.reasoning_content: Beatles covered "I Forgot to Remember to Forget" on BBC, sung by Paul? I recall Ringo sang it? Actually Beatles BBC version lead by Paul? I believe it was sung by Paul McCartney... not sure. Some say George sang Carl Perkins songs; "Forgot to Remember to Forget" was an Elvis song covered by Beatles at BBC, lead vocal Paul?
